title: validate_record input
description: Input for validate_record: one record and the schema it must satisfy. The `schema` member is the SAME subset structured_extract accepts, and it is sanitised by the SAME code, because a validator that disagreed with the extractor would make a returned record valid in one tool and invalid in the other. `record` is deliberately open (`additionalProperties: true`): the caller's schema decides which fields are allowed, so closing the envelope here would turn an unknown record field into a violation of THIS input rather than a verdict about the record.

record.description: The record to validate. It is data only: nothing here is executed, resolved, persisted or sent to a model.

schema.description: A JSON Schema object describing the record. Only the subset the engine's grammar compiler accepts is used: `type`, `properties`, `required`, `items`, `enum`, `const` and `description`. Unsupported keywords are REFUSED by name rather than silently dropped, because a dropped constraint would make this validator accept a record the extraction path would then reject.
